extDesc.message: Converts web links to QR codes with LinkQR

upgradeHttpToHttpsLabel.message: Automatically upgrade HTTP URLs to HTTPS

upgradeHttpToHttpsDescription.message: When enabled, LinkQR changes URLs beginning with http:// to https:// before generating a QR code. This applies to current-tab URLs, context-menu links, and URLs entered in LinkQR, across all Firefox windows. Some websites do not support HTTPS; turn this off to preserve their HTTP URLs.
